evals.prompt: Plan and atomically add a P2 Orders slice with Postgres, an external risk-score capability, and HTTP transport to apps/api. Do not infer product rules.
evals.expected_output: Reads an explicit Change Spec, generates semantic flat P2 files, keeps provider output as Candidate, creates public/wiring surfaces, stages the complete patch, updates managed registry/manifest atomically, and reports structural rather than compile/HTTP evidence unless project commands run.
expectations: Provider live implementation is behind an application-owned port.
Failure rolls back all affected managed/source files.

evals.prompt: The managed registry was edited by hand. Add another slice.
evals.expected_output: Detects managed drift and refuses apply until verify/repair resolves it; it does not overwrite the registry silently.
expectations: Managed hash drift is an error.
Project-owned source is not silently regenerated.
Repair only rebuilds managed files from a valid manifest.
